subject: general
question: In a row of a few students, P was standing 17th from the left end and 23rd from the right end. If Q was standing exactly in the middle of the row, what was his position from the extreme left end? Assume that the students were facing the north.
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Position of P from left end = 17
 
• Position of P from right end = 23
 
• Q is in the middle of the row.

**To find: **Position of Q from left end.

**Explanation:**

 
• Total number of students = Position of P from left end+Position of P from right end - 1
 
• &l
